dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for both station names, domains, official submission pages and dedicated music mailboxes. No existing WREK or KVRX route record was found. Each station was added once, with its email and physical paths consolidated into a single opportunity to prevent duplicate outreach to the same music department.
emailVerificationLevel: WREK officially publishes music.director@wrek.org for music submissions. KVRX officially publishes music@kvrx.org for music submissions and operations@kvrx.org only for related questions. The addresses are syntactically valid first-party domain mailboxes and were classified according to their stated purpose. Verification was limited to official publication, syntax, domain alignment and purpose binding. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email or music submission was sent; no package, track, stream, download, attachment, biography, press material, metadata, rights declaration, consent or personal data was supplied; no login, CAPTCHA, anti-spam, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
